title: We're Looking
values: ✓ You show up on time, prepared.
✓ You're curious: ask questions, give feedback.
✓ You play your class well (no parsing contest required).
✗ We don't care for: drama, ego, silent disappears.
expectations: Your first 4 raids are a trial (typically a 2-week window).
Discord is required during raids (comms and callouts).
Loot: raiders > trial > social. Fair and transparent.
If it's not working, we talk about it early.
about: From the Ashes is a community-first guild on Hellfire (EU), {member_count} members strong and {active_pct} active, currently {progression}. Mythic prog on one end; casuals, alts and zero-pressure socials on the other. We're here to have fun and support each other.
cta: Interested? DM an officer, or say hello in #recruitment first. We'd love to hear from you.
empty: The guild's full for now. But we're always happy to hear from you. DM an officer if you're interested; we rotate trials seasonally.
